summary: James McGuire, 56, hiking Arapahoe Peak with his two daughters, slipped and fell and injured his ankle; his daughter Erin also became stuck on the mountain face and needed rescue. Rocky Mountain Rescue, Nederland Fire and the Boulder County Sheriff's fire crew located both parties and evacuated them to the trailhead.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Nederland Fire Protection District; Boulder County Sheriff's Office
notes: McGuire was transported to Good Samaritan Hospital in Lafayette with an injured right ankle. Year pinned by story-ID sequence (1138 predates the Sep-2014 ID 1951); two victims = injured hiker + stranded daughter.
